feeds.title: Martha's Astrology Blog
feeds.description: I'm Martha Clarke - an astrologer, astrocartographer, and writer - and I use astrology sessions to help people realize their full potential. The blog explores the wisdom of astrology and astrocartography, sharing insights you can apply to your own life.

feeds.title: Andrew Smith Blog
feeds.description: Astrology has been my sole source of income, my way of being, and the way that I live since discovering it on the 17th Jan 1993. My focus is evident in my extensive public writing. I am interested in helping people develop deeper confidence in their commitment to what they love and living what they love. And I would love to share my passion with you and to work with you concerning what you love.

feeds.title: Astronomy Ireland
feeds.description: Astronomy Ireland is a nonprofit organization and the largest national astronomy club in the world relative to population and we publish a full-color 48-page magazine that is posted directly to members every month. Our aim is to promote astronomy, space interest, and education in Ireland.

feeds.title: Mythical Ireland Blog » Astronomy
feeds.description: Mythical Ireland explores Astronomy in this segment along with archaeology, mythology, alignments, and spirituality. Mythical Ireland was established in March of the year 2000 by author, journalist, astronomer, and photographer Anthony Murphy. The website represents a journey into the ancient past, casting new light on the early history of Ireland.
